paragraph: The Granville Composite opens at a constrained 60/100, as an active breadth warning caps the overall score due to rising SPY prices clashing with a declining equal-weight ratio (RSP/SPY down -0.18%). Internal signals reveal a divided tape, where strong leadership in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +1.22%) and high-beta risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV +0.64%) are offset by defensive rotation into staples (XLP/XLY +0.61%) and softening credit confidence (HYG/LQD -0.34%). Macro conditions remain broadly supportive of the current trend, highlighted by a complacent VIX at 14.76, stable 10-year real yields at 2.43%, and tight high-yield credit spreads at 2.71%. Furthermore, falling 5-year/5-year forward inflation expectations at 2.28% and a steady USD/JPY at ¥159.33 prevent any immediate macro contagion. Lean mildly bullish for today's session with a bias toward tech leadership, but expect index gains to remain constrained until broader participation confirms the rally.
